To evaluate this expression, we use PEMDAS.

We divide and multiply, from left to right:

$$
\begin{aligned}2÷6\times (-5) & = \\ (2÷6)\times (-5) & = \\ \frac{2}{6}\times (-5) & = \\ \frac{1}{3}\times (-5) & = \\ \frac{1}{3}\times \frac{(-5)}{1} & = \\ \frac{1\times (-5)}{3\times 1} & = \\ -\frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
